title: 2026-08-21-Q3-roadmap-launch-readiness-engineering-planning
summary: Planning session to align engineering and product on Q3 roadmap milestones and launch readiness actions. Focus on canary rollout plan, critical telemetry, capacity gating for Dedicated, and backlog items that must land before GA. Owners assigned for action items and follow-ups scheduled.
action_items: Tom Baker: Finalize KV cache rollback script and test in staging (due 2026-08-28)
Elena Gomez: Add two canary SLO dashboards + error budget burn alerts (due 2026-08-24)
Marcus Lee: Freeze API surface changes for launch and run compatibility tests (due 2026-08-25)
Sofia Park: Prepare playbook for Dedicated capacity gating and escalation (due 2026-08-26)
Priya Desai: Update launch checklist with legal/compliance signoff item and share with GTM (due 2026-08-23)
next_steps: Share final canary plan doc in #launch-readiness
Run end-to-end validation on staging tomorrow at 10:00
Schedule 30-min dry run with Support and CSM next Wednesday
Send updated launch checklist to execs for signoff
transcript:
Meeting header: 2026-08-21 15:00 PDT — duration 75 minutes. Attendees: Priya, Marcus, Elena, Tom, Sofia.

00:00 Priya: ok let's kick off, um, thanks everyone for joining, this is the Q3 roadmap launch readiness engineering planning, main goals are canary plan, telemetry, and Dedicated gating.
01:05 Marcus: agreed, we've got three engineering blockers flagged: kv cache stability under long contexts, memory leak on shared worker, and the recent autoscaler flake.
02:20 Elena: yeah the autoscaler flake — i re-ran the repro and it's intermittent, looks like race when pod metrics are delayed. i'll add a jitter and longer timeout but we need better tracing.
03:10 Tom: on kv cache, last night the staging run showed a KV miss storm when we hit 3k concurrent sessions, possibly eviction thrash. I have a mitigation that pins hot prefixes and adds a fallback to prefix cache.
04:15 Priya: is that safe for GA? we need a rollback plan if the pinning causes regressions.
04:35 Tom: yes, i'll produce a rollback script that flips a flag and clears pinned prefixes, and we'll smoke test. target end of next week.
06:00 Elena: telemetry — i want two dashboards: canary latency percentiles and error budget burn, plus a spike detector for 95th percentile increases. also need a paging alert if error rate > 1% sustained 5m.
07:10 Marcus: agree, and add an alert for latency tail above 1.5x baseline. Priya, what's our SLO target for canary?
07:40 Priya: target is p50 < 200ms and p95 < 800ms for the hosted route; Dedicated can be a bit looser in first weeks but we need clear expectations.
09:05 Sofia: for gating Dedicated capacity, we should have automatic traffic shaping: 10% to canary for 48h, if no issues 30% for next 24h, then ramp to 100. Also require that errors and latency alerts are green for 48h.
10:40 Marcus: do we plan to use region routing fallback? e.g., if one region sees issues, auto-fallback to another region for some customers.
11:00 Elena: we have smart routing available but need to configure it per customer tier, and ensure KV cache warmup won't cause cold penalties. that's a config item.
12:25 Priya: legal and security signoff — compliance needs SOC2 evidence and KMS key rotation policy documented. Who owns that?
12:45 Marcus: Security already has docs but i'll loop in Compliance to get a formal signoff. Priya, you'll add it to the checklist.
13:30 Priya: ok i'll add compliance signoff and include KMS/HSM keys note.
14:00 Tom: there's also a potential perf regression from the new attention kernel. It's faster on average but some long-context cases spike RAM usage by 10%. We should gate it behind a feature flag.
15:05 Elena: feature flag + staged rollout for kernel change makes sense. We can instrument memory usage per container and alert.
16:30 Tom: on API surface, can we freeze changes? we need to avoid any last-minute shape changes to the model input that break SDKs.
16:55 Marcus: i'll coordinate a freeze—no breaking API changes after Friday. We'll run compatibility tests against the SDK matrix.
18:10 Priya: outstanding items: playbook for rollback, telemetry dashboards, API freeze, compliance signoff, canary ramp plan. Let's assign owners.
19:20 Sofia: i'll draft playbook for Dedicated gating and escalation and include contact lists, runbook steps, and rollback triggers.
20:45 Priya: good. also, schedule a dry run with Support and CSM — we don't want surprises during traffic ramp.
21:10 Marcus: timeline check: we want the dry run next week, canary start on 2026-08-30, GA the following week, contingent on no major regressions.
22:35 Elena: i'll add two dashboards and set alerts, and run a staging canary tonight to verify metrics collection.
24:00 Tom: i'll finish the KV rollback script by Friday and test it in staging, plus gate the attention kernel behind a flag.
25:30 Priya: quick note on docs — Dev Portal needs an updated rollout guide and troubleshooting section. Mark that as doc item.
26:00 Marcus: ok we'll update the portal; docs owner is product docs but engineering will provide steps.
27:10 Sofia: dependencies — GTM needs the pricing and capacity numbers for Dedicated so they can prepare sales enablement. Who's feeding that?
27:40 Priya: Finance is finalizing pricing, but engineering needs to share realistic throughput and cost-per-token estimates. Marcus, can your team produce a short spreadsheet?
28:05 Marcus: yes, we'll run benchmarks on the final quant settings and post numbers by 2026-08-24.
29:30 Elena: also bring up the KV cache warmup approach for Dedicated customers; it's key for tail latency steady-state.
30:15 Tom: plan is to pre-warm top prefixes during canary and use on-demand warmed caches otherwise; we'll document that.
31:40 Priya: risk review — list top 3 risks and mitigation. Marcus?
32:00 Marcus: 1) KV eviction thrash — mitigation: pin hot prefixes + rollback script. 2) Autoscaler non-determinism — mitigation: timeout/jitter and improved metrics. 3) Memory spike from new kernel — mitigation: feature flag + staged rollout.
33:20 Elena: add monitoring gap as a risk if dashboards aren't ready before canary.
34:00 Priya: action owners noted. Any blockers from infra?
34:30 Tom: we need an extra staging cluster for the dry run for isolation — i've requested capacity but it's tentative.
35:10 Sofia: if staging cluster isn't available we'll run a blue/green within the current staging but it reduces isolation risk. I prefer an isolated cluster though.
36:40 Marcus: i'll follow up with infra and escalate if needed.
37:20 Priya: ok, let's recap next steps and owners.
38:00 Recap: Tom - KV rollback & attention kernel flag; Elena - dashboards + alerts; Marcus - API freeze & benchmark spreadsheet; Sofia - Dedicated playbook & dry run coordination; Priya - update checklist and share with GTM.
40:10 Priya: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene after the staging canary results.
41:00 Sofia: scheduling follow-up for 30 minutes next Monday.
42:00 End of meeting.

Notes: Transcript contains minor transcription artifacts and filler words; timestamps approximate. References to KV cache, quantization, Dedicated, canary, SLOs, KMS/HSM. Shared artifacts referenced: canary-plan.docx (in drive), launch-checklist.md (in repo), benchmark-spreadsheet.xlsx (link to be shared).
